item.name: Drafting Table
item.description: Spread out the farm plans: see the whole farm from above, order buildings from Robin and lay out decorations from your backpack.
hint.view: Drag to move the map, pinch with two fingers (or use - / +) to zoom.
hint.build: Pick a building below, tap the map to position it, then press Build. Robin builds one thing at a time.
hint.place: Pick an item below, then tap tiles to place it. Hold and drag to paint paths and fences. Two fingers move the map.
hint.remove: Tap or drag over things you placed (paths, fences, machines, decor) to put them back in your backpack. Two fingers move the map.
build.none: Robin has nothing to build for you right now.
build.pickFirst: Pick a building in the list first.
build.tapMap: Now tap the map where it should stand.
build.canPlace: Fits here. Press Build to order it.
build.cantPlace: Can't build here: something is in the way.
build.robinBusy: Robin is already building something. Wait until it's finished.
build.done: Ordered: {0}. Robin will finish in {1} days.
place.none: Nothing in your backpack can be placed outside.
place.pickFirst: Pick an item in the list first.
place.runOut: You ran out of that item.
remove.notAllowed: This can't be picked up here.
remove.notEmpty: Empty it first (machine is working or chest has items).
remove.table: Use the 'Pick up table' button in the View tab.
